description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core minimal API endpoint for updating a catalog item in the eShop web application. It includes route setup, authorization, and logic to handle the update operation, interacting with a repository and returning the updated item as a DTO.

classes.name: UpdateCatalogItemEndpoint
classes.description: Defines a minimal API endpoint for updating catalog items, handling routing, authorization, and business logic.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the PUT route to update a catalog item with authorization and request handling.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Performs the update operation: fetching existing item, updating details, saving, and returning the updated DTO.
